    Amazon Customer
    1 out of 5 stars
    Very pathetic laptop
    Do not buy this laptop. I ordered hp 15 125h, 24gb ram and 1tb ssd during amazon summer sale. When I opened the laptop it was good. But after initial full charge i observed that the battery became very hot and laptop started draining battery (10% in 30 min) even after not using much. Also it's touchscreen variant which is why maybe battery must be draining. This is not mentioned in advertisement. Then second day yellow spot appeared on laptop. I contacted amazon and hp and they created dead on arrival case for it after inspection. The communication with hp was not that easy. Really frustrated buying this piece. Do not go for this version mentioned above.
